settings.editor:
BioQuantum Sciences is a Texas-based supplier of research peptides and bioregulators dedicated to analytical quality, scientific transparency, and regulatory-conscious operations.

Formerly operating as AmeriQuantum Sciences, our company was established to address the growing demand for rigorously tested, research-grade compounds.

Our catalog spans GLP-1 / Incretin analogs, recovery and repair peptides, mitochondrial and longevity compounds, immune-support bioregulators, hormonal research compounds, and Khavinson cytomax bioregulators.

Our mission is to advance the frontiers of biomedical research by providing scientists, clinicians, and institutions with reliably sourced, analytically verified research compounds that meet or exceed industry purity and identity standards. We are committed to transparency, scientific integrity, regulatory compliance, and the responsible advancement of peptide science. BioQuantum Sciences operates in full compliance with applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations governing the distribution of research compounds and is committed to updating its website, policies, and operational procedures promptly upon receipt of new regulatory requirements or guidance.
